_about: Hand-written stand-in for the events_news model's answer to the 15 dated items in news_items.json (real news_items rows pulled 2026-09-30). No model was called. Each event names its item by title ('for'); the test turns that into the index the model would give. Events marked 'planted' are deliberate mistakes of the kinds models make, there for the gate to catch.

events.subject: Ethereum Glamsterdam
events.title: Ethereum activates Glamsterdam on the Sepolia testnet
events.why: Last testnet step before Glamsterdam's mainnet date is set
events.quote: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia for Oct. 6
